The Florida Ottoman Bed is for anyone who needs generous underbed storage without giving up style. The versatile Florida-style headboard sits on a smooth hydraulic gas lift ottoman base, and the whole bed is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Florida-style upholstered headboard
  • Hydraulic gas lift, end-opening ottoman base
  • Large underbed storage compartment
  • Available in all five UK bed sizes
  • Free fabric swatches before you buy

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £357.99; Small Double (4FT) £454.99; Double (4FT6) £467.99; King (5FT) £519.99; Super King (6FT) £623.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How does the ottoman open?

The mattress platform lifts from the foot end on hydraulic gas struts, giving you access to the large storage compartment underneath.

Where is the Florida Ottoman Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Related: ottoman beds, storage beds.
